title: Game Changing Onyo Bacon Jam
description: A game-changing bacon jam recipe that can be made in advance and frozen for later use. Perfect for serving on steak, hamburgers, or anywhere you want a burst of flavor.
steps: Take the bacon out and use the bacon fat to sauté the onion.
If there is too much fat, scrape the bottom of the pot to get the goodies.
Add chili peppers, black peppers, salt, fresh thyme, and garlic.
Add brown sugar, adjusting based on the sweetness of your vinegar.
Lower the heat to avoid burning the pot.
Let this cook for a few minutes until well reduced.
Add a little bit of bourbon, if desired.
Add some fresh parsley at the last minute.
notes:
This jam can be made in advance and frozen for a very long time. It is excellent served on steak, hamburgers, or anywhere you want to add flavor. It can be stored in small containers like pesto.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/199qAu8Q6y/

Nutrition: Serving 1 tablespoon · Calories 75 · Fat 6g · Saturated fat 2g · Unsaturated fat 4g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 15mg · Sodium 150mg · Carbs 5g · Fiber 0.5g · Sugar 4g · Protein 2g

healthy: Onion, garlic, chili peppers and herbs add some plant nutrients.
Used as a condiment, so portions are small.
not_healthy: Bacon is processed meat high in sodium and saturated fat.
Brown sugar, maple syrup and maple balsamic add a lot of sugar.
